title: fig05 stimulus-window extension complete: vs-V1 is null (informative), full pairwise is significant and structured
notes: Completes the stimulus-window extension requested after fig05's omission-window headline was resolved. New census (compute_stim_channel_band_power_census.py) ran to completion: 303 files x 3 slots, 420,480 rows, 23 sessions, ~85 min runtime, row count matching the omission census exactly.
fit_stim_band_power_glmm.py (shared area_subject_glmm.py Model F) fit cleanly, no errors/notes.

vs-V1 family (45 cells): NULL -- 0/45 Holm, 0/45 BH-FDR. Some point estimates are visually large (PFC low-gamma -3.5dB, MST low-gamma +3.3dB) but none survive the 45-test correction (raw p 0.008-0.05, wide CIs). Verified this is a real null and not a rendering bug: the heatmap correctly shows large colors with NO significance outline anywhere, matching the underlying stats file exactly.

Full pairwise family (225 cells): SIGNIFICANT -- 30/225 Holm, 55/225 BH-FDR. Areas differ strongly from each other in the stimulus window (FEF vs MT beta p_holm=1.5e-11, FST vs PFC beta p_holm=7e-10, MST vs PFC/TEO low-gamma p_holm~1e-8) -- tiny p-values, n=23 sessions, a real and well-powered effect. MST is a visually clear outlier from most other areas in low/high-gamma.

Scientific interpretation (descriptive, not overclaimed): the omission-linked area hierarchy that survives correction specifically relative to V1 does NOT replicate for a real stimulus relative to V1 -- but areas still differ from EACH OTHER during real stimuli, just not in the V1-anchored pattern the omission window shows. This argues the omission main-figure result is more specific than a generic 'areas differ' baseline fact, which strengthens rather than undermines it.

Both stimulus-window panels (vs-V1 heatmap, full pairwise matrix) added as supplements S32/S33 in build_supplements.py's PLAN, not folded into the main figure -- the main figure's claim is about the omission window specifically. Verified via --list (resolves) and a real build (32 supplements built, 0 skipped) and build_inventory.py --check (passes).
plan: fig05 is now complete for this session's scope: main figure (omission, significant), 4 supplements (omission pairwise, stim vs-V1 null, stim pairwise significant, plus the 3 preserved connectivity-null supplements). Ready for the usual review-then-lock pass whenever that's done across the pipeline.
Proceed to fig07 (LFP-SPK directed panel, previously authorized).
